messages.text: السلام عليكم

reference: وعليكم السلام، أهلاً بك في بولكس موتورز. كيف أقدر أساعدك اليوم؟

messages.text: hi

reference: Hello, welcome to Pollux Motors. What can I help you find today?

messages.text: Bonjour

reference: Bonjour et bienvenue chez Pollux Motors. Que puis-je vous montrer aujourd'hui ?

messages.text: بكم اللاند كروزر ٢٠٢٣ الأبيض؟

reference: اللاند كروزر 4.0 موديل 2023 أبيض متوفرة، السعر AED 235,000. تحب تشوفها السبت؟

messages.text: bkm el hilux gr sport?

reference: El Hilux GR Sport 2023 b-AED 165,000. Te7eb teegy teshofha?

messages.text: how much is the Land Cruiser?

reference: The Land Cruiser 4.0 2023 is AED 235,000. Would you like to see it this week?

messages.text: price for the BYD Seal 05 please

reference: The BYD Seal 05 2024 is AED 89,000. Shall I book you a test drive?

messages.text: Quel est le prix du Hilux diesel ?

reference: Le Hilux 2.8 Diesel 2022 est à AED 128,000. C'est pour l'export ou pour ici ?

messages.text: كم سعر الباترول؟

reference: الباترول 2022 سعرها AED 210,000، لكنها محجوزة حالياً. تحب أعرض عليك بديل؟

messages.text: what's your best price on the Land Cruiser? can you do 220?

reference: The listed price is AED 235,000. Let me check with my manager what we can do and come back to you today.

messages.text: 3andkom 7aga arkhas mn 100 alf?

reference: Aywa, fi BYD Seal 05 2024 b-AED 89,000. Te7eb tefaselha?

messages.text: do you still have the Hilux GR Sport?

reference: Yes, the Hilux GR Sport 2023 is still with us at AED 165,000. When would you like to come in?

messages.text: الباترول لازالت متوفرة؟

reference: الباترول محجوزة حالياً لعميل آخر. عندي لاند كروزر 2023 أبيض، تحب أرسل لك التفاصيل؟

messages.text: is the BMW X5 still available?

reference: The X5 has been sold, I am sorry. Would a Land Cruiser 2023 or a Patrol interest you instead?

messages.text: Avez-vous des Hilux en stock ?

reference: Oui, nous avons le Hilux GR Sport 2023 à AED 165,000 et le Hilux 2.8 Diesel 2022 à AED 128,000. Lequel vous intéresse ?

messages.text: 3andkom land cruiser abyad?

reference: Aywa, Land Cruiser 4.0 2023 abyad, b-AED 235,000. Te7eb teshofha el sabt?

messages.text: any electric cars?

reference: We have the BYD Seal 05 2024 at AED 89,000. Would you like to see it?

messages.text: what engine does the Land Cruiser have and how many km?

reference: The Land Cruiser 2023 has the 4.0 V6 and 18,000 km on the clock. Shall I send you photos?

messages.text: كم ممشى الهايلكس الديزل؟

reference: الهايلكس 2.8 ديزل موديل 2022 ممشاها 62,000 كم. تحب تشوف الصور؟

messages.text: Le Seal 05 a quelle autonomie et quelle couleur ?

reference: Le BYD Seal 05 2024 que nous avons est blanc. Pour l'autonomie exacte je vérifie et je reviens vers vous.

messages.text: do you export to Algeria? what documents do I need?

reference: Yes, we export to Algeria. We need a passport copy, a certificate of residence there, and the consignee's details in Latin letters. Which car are you looking at?

messages.text: ممكن تصدروا السيارة للجزائر؟ كم تاخذ الشحنة؟

reference: نعم نصدّر للجزائر، والشحن من جبل علي يستغرق حوالي 14 يوماً. أي سيارة تفكر فيها؟

messages.text: Quand partent les bateaux pour Alger ?

reference: Les départs roll-on roll-off sont chaque mardi depuis Jebel Ali, environ 14 jours jusqu'à Alger. Quelle voiture vous intéresse ?

messages.text: who pays the customs when it lands?

reference: Customs duty is paid by the buyer on arrival and is never in our price. We issue the certificate of origin and the invoice.

messages.text: momken tsaderoha l Casablanca?

reference: Aywa, benshan l Casablanca, el shahn 7awali 18 yom mn Jebel Ali. Ay arabeya feb alak?

messages.text: can I pay monthly? how much per month for the Hilux?

reference: We can arrange finance for UAE residents with 20% down. The monthly figure depends on the bank's rate on the day, so I cannot quote one yet. Shall I start the application?

messages.text: كم الدفعة الأولى للتمويل؟

reference: الدفعة الأولى 20% من سعر السيارة، والمدة من 12 إلى 60 شهراً. تحب نبدأ الإجراءات؟

messages.text: Je peux financer si j'achète pour l'export ?

reference: Le financement est réservé aux résidents des Émirats. Pour un achat à l'export, c'est comptant ou virement bancaire.

messages.text: I have a 2019 Prado with 90,000 km. what would you give me for it?

reference: We do take trade-ins. We need to see the car at the showroom before anyone can put a figure on it — the inspection takes forty minutes and is free. When suits you?

messages.text: عندي سيارة أبي أبدلها، كم تقدرون تعطوني؟

reference: نستبدل السيارات، لكن لازم نشوف السيارة في المعرض قبل ما نحدد القيمة. الفحص مجاني ويأخذ حوالي 40 دقيقة. متى يناسبك؟

messages.text: can I come see the Land Cruiser on Saturday?

reference: Of course. Saturday works — what time suits you? We are open 09:00 to 18:00.

messages.text: أبي أجرب السيارة، متى أقدر أجي؟

reference: أهلاً، نقدر نرتب لك تجربة. تحب السبت الساعة 11 صباحاً؟

messages.text: Je peux passer demain matin ?

reference: Oui, nous ouvrons à 09:00. Vers quelle heure souhaitez-vous venir ?

messages.text: how do I pay? can I transfer from my brother's account?

reference: Transfers have to come from an account in the buyer's own name, and we release the car once the funds clear. Shall I send you the details?

messages.text: 3ayez a3raf el awra2 el matlouba l el shera

reference: Han7tag soret el passport w el 3enwan bel Latin. Te7eb ab3atlak el list kamla?

messages.text: another dealer offered me the same Hilux for 155. match it and I'll buy today

reference: Our price is AED 165,000. Let me speak to my manager about what we can do and come straight back to you.

messages.text: آخر سعر كم للاند كروزر؟

reference: السعر المعلن AED 235,000. خلني أتواصل مع المدير وأرجع لك اليوم.

messages.text: I came yesterday and nobody helped me. this is the third time. I'm done

reference: I am sorry — that should not have happened. Let me get the showroom manager to call you today. What number is best?

messages.text: can someone call me please

reference: Of course. What time today suits you for a call?

messages.text: please don't message me about cars again
